design.directionOnlyComposition: Direct numeric Fire Rate item inputs, permanent Fire Rate accumulation, and Gun bridge enter/exit provide expected direction only. Values are not added across sources and no final Fire Rate formula is assumed.
design.unresolvedFireRateModifiers: Transitions changing non-direct or non-numeric Fire Rate inputs are classified ambiguous and excluded from the primary directional agreement rate.

semanticLimits.readyDelay: Script162 establishes an extremely strong lower-bound candidate in this discovery replay, not yet cross-replay effective-cadence authority.
semanticLimits.fireRate: Script163 tests directional response of the observed engine ready-delay to known Fire Rate input changes. It does not establish an additive/multiplicative stacking formula.
semanticLimits.ammo: PlayerState maxAmmo is excluded from magazine-capacity composition because Script162 observed maxAmmo=0 throughout the comparable test-replay events.
